## 构建

根目录 `CMakeLists.txt` 是顶层构建脚本（`cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)`，`project(dde-session)`）。

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build -j"$(nproc)"
sudo cmake --install build
```

## 依赖

`debian/control` 的 `Build-Depends` 共 15 项，以下为前 8 项（完整列表见 `debian/control`）：

- `cmake`
- `debhelper-compat (= 11)`
- `libcap-ng-dev`
- `libdtk6core-dev`
- `libdtk6core-bin`
- `libglib2.0-dev`
- `libsecret-1-dev`
- `libsystemd-dev`

顶层 `CMakeLists.txt` 用 `find_package` 查找 2 个包：`DtkBuildHelper`、`Dtk`。

## 打包

`debian/` 目录提供 Debian 打包文件（`control`、`changelog`、`rules`、`copyright`、`source/format`）。

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| 源包名 | `velora-session` |
| 二进制包 | `dde-session` |
| 版本 | `2.1.29.lingmo5u1`（`debian/changelog`） |
| Section | `devel` |
| Homepage | https://github.com/LingmoOS/velora-session |

```bash
sudo apt build-dep .
dpkg-buildpackage -uc -us -nc -b
```
